text:
maria: quick heads-up: after last night's SDK rollout I'm seeing missing telemetry headers on eu-canary which breaks our rate-limiting middleware. Thinking a targeted SDK pin on eu-canary would be safest until we patch. Need ops + QA ack.

deploy-bot: [scan] header-mismatch-detect: target=eu-canary, symptom=missing-x-rw-client header (observed 12/1500 requests), suggested action: add sdk-pin:sdk@2.7.6 to eu-canary pinlist.
jin: do we have repro? is this header stripped by the new SDK or renamed?
maria: small log snippet from canary proxy:
```
WARN middleware: request missing header x-rw-client, client_id=unknown, path=/v1/generate
Trace: proxy->sdk-shim v2.8.0 -> runtime 3.1.4
```

ops-lead: if header is missing, rate limiter treats as anonymous and applies strict limits. That causes 429s for internal health checks. Agree to a short pin while we investigate.
tara: +1 from SRE. Suggest change window 20m and notify infra teams. Rollback threshold: >0.3% 429s on canary -> immediate rollback.

qa-bot: smoke summary (pre-pin): basic_api PASS, telemetry_headers FAIL (12 missing), rate_limit_checks FAIL (5/1500 429s). link: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/telemetry/3321

deploy-bot: queued action: apply pinlist entry -> target=eu-canary, entry=sdk-pin:sdk@2.7.6, reason="telemetry header regression", requested_by=maria, runbook_ref=/runbooks/eu-telemetry-pin.md

jin: initial hypothesis: SDK 2.8.0 switched to camelCase header normalization and our proxy expects lower-case dashed headers. Quick fix: backport header-normalization fallback in sdk@2.8.1 or pin to 2.7.6.

doc-bot: reminder: when applying temporary pins, add an entry to release-notes under "hotfixes" with a short description; automated template at /docs/release-templates/hotfix-pin.md

maria: plan: apply pin now, run canary smoke at +10m, hold for 4h or until we release sdk@2.8.1 with fallback. Commands: `/deploy pinlist add eu-canary sdk-pin:sdk@2.7.6 --reason "telemetry header regression"` and unpin: `/deploy pinlist remove eu-canary sdk-pin:sdk@2.7.6`. Rollback: `/deploy rollback eu-canary --to sdk@2.7.6`.

deploy-bot: [completed] pin applied id=pin-20240512-telemetry-01 at 1812340050

qa-bot: post-pin smoke: telemetry_headers PASS (sampled 2000 requests), rate_limit_checks PASS, basic_api PASS. details: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/telemetry/3323

ops-lead: documenting change window (change-id=chg-20240512-eu-telemetry), notifying security and infra. We'll hold pin for 4h or until sdk patch lands.

jin: working on 2.8.1 fallback PR now. If CI green we'll release and coordinate unpin. ETA ~2h.

maria: checklist: [x] pin applied [x] smoke green [ ] 2.8.1 validated [ ] unpin scheduled. tagging @tara for rollout ops.

deploy-bot: thread closed: monitor until explicit unpin. If rollback criteria hit, open incident and escalate.
